# @Generated by scripts/gen_victory.py
#   Data:    data/victory_paths.yaml + data/io_establishment.yaml + data/io_leaders.yaml + data/pulse_registry.yaml
#   Regen:   conda run --no-capture-output -n eu5 python scripts/gen_victory.py
# Do not edit directly — modify the data file and re-run the generator.

tv_victory_situation = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique

	can_start = {
		always = yes
	}

	can_end = {
		always = no    # Permanent situation — never ends naturally
	}

	visible = {
		always = yes
	}

	on_start = {
		# Initialise the AI yearly pulse counter on the situation scope
		set_variable = { name = tv_ai_pulse_counter value = 0 }
		# Initialise every country; the expensive science scan is player-only.
		every_country = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				tv_update_science_score_effect = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_victory_selected_path } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_victory_selected_path value = 0 }
			}
			tv_check_all_milestones_effect = yes
			tv_update_all_progress_pct_effect = yes
		}
		# Build initial leaderboard ranking immediately
		tv_update_leaderboard_effect = yes
	}

	on_monthly = {
		hidden_effect = {
			# ── PLAYER MILESTONE CHECKS (every month) ────────────────────────────────
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = no
				}
				tv_check_all_milestones_effect = yes
				tv_update_all_progress_pct_effect = yes
			}

			# ── AI MILESTONE CHECKS (every 12 months, via counter) ────────────────────
			change_variable = { name = tv_ai_pulse_counter add = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_ai_pulse_counter >= 12 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_ai_pulse_counter value = 0 }
				# Yearly prosperity score update for ALL countries (expensive every_owned_location iteration)
				every_country = {
					tv_update_prosperity_score_effect = yes
				}
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						is_ai = yes
					}
					tv_check_all_milestones_effect = yes
					tv_update_all_progress_pct_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_ended = {
		# Should never fire — tv_victory_situation is permanent
	}
}

tv_academy_world_debate_situation = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique

	can_start = {
		always = yes
	}

	can_end = {
		always = no
	}

	visible = {
		has_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_participant
	}

	on_start = {
		tv_academy_world_debate_initialize_effect = yes
	}

	on_monthly = {
		hidden_effect = {
			tv_academy_world_debate_monthly_effect = yes
		}
	}

	on_ended = {
	}
}
